decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot builds directly on the firm's in-house formwork, robotics and control knowledge, so its own R&D can absorb field results and keep improving it.
Automatic de-shuttering sits in the firm's core precast automation competence, so it can interpret customer feedback and refine the robot rather than abandon it.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots and draws on established material-handling and control expertise, giving it integration and learning value within automated plants.
Automatic shuttering is central to the firm's automated precast portfolio, and its related knowledge and engineering capacity let it develop the product commercially.
The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting line extends well-understood pallet circulation technology across several models, so the firm can readily assimilate early market results.
Production analysis software builds on the firm's control and planning software know-how and generates data that strengthens its learning about customer plants and lifecycle services.
